summary:
We develop a interactive website with Claude that's intended for 8-12 year olders. We want them to lear about the mission Survayor 3 that helped the NASA learn about the moon and its surface. This mission was one of the most influential for the NASA to aquire one of their most ambitious missions (Apolo 11). 

Our goal it's not just teach children about this mission, also to frame a message. Everybody remebers Apolo 11. Neil Amstrong, the first man on the moon, and his famous quote "That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mindkind" but we always forget about the process. 

We think that sometimes the best stories are not the most loudly ones. Frequently, we forget from those who helped us to reach our goals. So that's what why we decided to make a story about Survayor 3. To give it it's place and relevance in history it deserves, for those who doesn't know or those who may fortgot, know they can find a place in which they can learn more about it.
details:
What does it or how does it work? Our project is a educational Game based on NASA's Surveyor 3 Mission. In this game users can experience a lunar landing, explore de moon, dig into the lunar soil, ando learn about challenges the probe faced. They can also discover its connection with the Apolo 12 Mission.

What benefits does it have? Our game offers a fun way about space exploration. It helps users understand the important of robotics missions and how old space equipment can still provide useful scientific information.

What is the intended impact of the project? We want to make young people more interesed in science, technology and space exploration. Wey also want to show that every space mission can leave important knowledge for the future.

What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use to develop your project? We use HTML, CSS and Java Script to create the game, its design and interactive activities. Wey also used oficial NASA information for educational content.

How is your project creative? Our project is creative because users don't just read about Surveyor 3. They can play, explore, ando experience some of the challenges the probe faced on the Moon.

What factors did your team consider? Wey considered the accuracy of the information, the game design and how easy it is to play. Wey also wanted it to be fun, educational, and available in both English and Spanish.
